class.name: InventoryResult
class.brief_description: Terminal result of a coordinated inventory pickup.

method.name: is_ok
method.description: True when both the source consumption and backpack placement committed.

method.name: get_item_id
method.description: Committed item instance ID, or empty on failure.

method.name: get_origin
method.description: Zero-based top-left cell of the committed placement, or (-1, -1) on failure.

method.name: get_revision
method.description: Coordinator revision at commit, or -1 on failure.
